title: Snack Time
can_do: I can name simple foods and ask politely.

unit_story.title: Snack Time Story
text: Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto are at the classroom snack table.
Leo sees an apple. Mia sees juice. Emma sees a sandwich.
Leo says, “I want an apple, please.”
Emma says, “I want a sandwich, please.”
Toto sits and smiles. Snack time is kind and polite.

lessons.title: Snack Words
lessons.can_do: I can point to and say snack words.
lessons.kp: VOC: snack words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
study: Extra picture words: cake, bread. These are look-and-say words only.
lessons.try_it: Point to three snacks and say the word: apple, banana, cookie.
lessons.repair_hint: If you are not sure, look at the tray again and say one word only.

lessons.title: I Want...
lessons.can_do: I can say what snack I want.
lessons.kp: CHK: I want ...; VOC: snack choice; SI: answer a simple choice question
lessons.try_it: Choose one snack. Say: I want _____.
lessons.repair_hint: Start with the chunk I want. Then add one snack word.

lessons.title: Please
lessons.can_do: I can ask for a snack politely.
lessons.kp: CHK: I want ..., please.; REG: friendly polite asking; SI: helper/learner exchange
lessons.try_it: Ask a friend politely: I want a/an _____, please.
lessons.repair_hint: If please is missing, say the whole line again with please at the end.

lessons.title: A / An Snack Chunks
lessons.can_do: I can notice and use fixed snack chunks: a banana, an apple.
lessons.kp: GRM: a/an noticing as fixed chunks only; VOC: snack chunks; STR: repair by model copying
study: Listen and copy the chunk. Do not explain it. Just say it.
a banana · a sandwich · a cookie
lessons.try_it: Hold a snack card. Say the full chunk: a banana / an apple.
lessons.repair_hint: Use the repair picture. Copy the full chunk, not only the food word.

lessons.title: Drinks
lessons.can_do: I can name simple drinks and choose one drink.
lessons.kp: VOC: drink words; CHK: I want water/milk/juice, please.; SI: simple choice
lessons.try_it: Choose one drink and say: I want _____, please.
lessons.repair_hint: For drinks, use the drink word after I want: I want juice, please.

lessons.title: Snack Order Role-play
lessons.can_do: I can ask for one snack and one drink in a short role-play.
lessons.kp: SI: snack order role-play; CHK: I want ..., please.; VOC: snack + drink; REG: thank you
study: Learner: I want an apple and water, please.
model: I want a sandwich and juice, please.
lessons.try_it: Work with a partner. Choose one snack and one drink. Say the role-play.
lessons.repair_hint: If the line is too long, say it in two parts: I want a sandwich. I want juice, please.

lessons.title: Project Rehearsal
lessons.can_do: I can make and rehearse my snack order card.
lessons.kp: PRJ: project rehearsal; SP: short snack order; WRT: copy one snack word and one drink word; STR: self-check
study: My line: I want an apple and water, please.
model: My snack is a cookie. My drink is juice.
I want a cookie and juice, please.
lessons.try_it: Draw or choose one snack and one drink. Practice your line two times.
lessons.repair_hint: Check three parts: snack word, drink word, please.

watch.title: Toto and the Snack Card
watch.video_or_placeholder: Video placeholder now; later MP4 can use Unit 9 images and captions.
watch.summary: A short Pre-A1 snack-choice story. Leo, Mia, and Emma choose one snack or drink politely while Toto watches the snack card.

script.caption: Snack Time. Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto are ready.
Leo says, “I want an apple, please.”
Emma looks at the snack card.
Emma says, “I want a sandwich, please.”
The team says, “Thank you!” Snack time is polite.

watch.project_connection: Learners reuse the same pattern in My Snack Order Role-play.

project.title: My Snack Order Role-play
project.output_type: one snack order card + one short spoken role-play
steps: Choose one snack: an apple, a banana, an orange, a sandwich, or a cookie.
Choose one drink: water, milk, or juice.
Make a simple snack order card.
Practice the line: I want ____ and ____, please.
Say the role-play with a helper: Hello. / I want ____ and ____, please. / Here you are. / Thank you.
phrase_bank: I want a banana and juice, please.
project.portfolio_evidence: photo of snack order card + short speaking recording of the role-play
